QUOTE: "If the integrator never sets `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC`, the default is `platform_calloc_uninit`, which returns NULL. `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_FREE` defaults to a no-op. So an unconfigured build fails allocations rather than silently calling libc."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the uninitialised defaults make calloc return NULL and free do nothing, so allocations fail instead of falling back to libc.
